name: Grenka's Claw
summary: In Thousand Needles, Grenka's Claw marks survival in the depths of Roguefeather Den. At the Weathered Nook, Dorn Plainstalker receives it as proof of an aspiring adventurer's endurance in the canyon heights.

sections.title: A Trophy of Endurance
sections.body: Harpies cache food in Roguefeather Den, west of Freewind Post, and fiercely guard their territory. Dorn Plainstalker sends young champions into the deep roosts to destroy the flock's food reserves and test their strength. Such an intrusion draws Grenka Bloodscreech's fury. Returning her wicked talon proves a warrior endured wave after wave of enraged harpies and survived their matriarch's vicious assault.

faq.q: What is Grenka's Claw used for?
aliases: why do i need grenkas claw
faq.answer: At the Weathered Nook in Thousand Needles, Dorn Plainstalker accepts the claw as proof of victory. Giving it to him completes the Test of Endurance and shows you can survive a long fight.
Grenka Bloodscreech is a powerful harpy in Roguefeather Den, in Screeching Canyon along Thousand Needles' southern cliffs. She emerges when intruders threaten the flock by destroying its stored food.

faq.q: Where do I take the claw once I obtain it?
aliases: where to turn in grenka claw
faq.answer: Take the claw to Dorn Plainstalker at the Weathered Nook in the bluffs of Thousand Needles. He accepts it as proof that you passed the trial of physical endurance.

faq.q: Why does Dorn Plainstalker demand this specific trophy?
faq.answer: Dorn Plainstalker guides young travelers through hard trials to ready their minds, spirits, and bodies for greater perils. Slaying Grenka and claiming her claw proves a warrior can endure a swarm's ambush and the deadly leader's direct assault.

angles.text: Elder Dorn Plainstalker sees it as his sacred duty to prepare young Horde champions for the wider, harsher world through the wisdom and grit of tauren rites.
Clearing Roguefeather Den's deep reaches and killing Grenka Bloodscreech blunts the harpy threat that constantly harasses travelers around Freewind Post.
